name: Fog Over Marshmot
source:
Welcome to Marshmot, where interesting folks and fascinating happenings reside!
It has many tales, but this is just one of them.

Bat Van Amstel is getting sick of his boring job at the wig store which he has been stuck in for years. A friend tells him he should quit, but should he? What will happen once he finally does?... Who even owns that place?

[From [url=https://stay-puff.itch.io/fog-over-marshmot]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Marshmot，这里有有趣的人和有趣的事情！
它有很多故事，但这只是其中之一。

巴特·范·阿姆斯特尔 (Bat Van Amstel) 厌倦了他在假发店里呆了多年的无聊工作。一个朋友告诉他应该戒烟，但是他应该戒烟吗？一旦他最终做到了，会发生什么？……谁拥有那个地方？

[来自[url=https://stay-puff.itch.io/fog-over-marshmot]Itch.io[/url]]
